column2: Efficient logistics allowed the online store to deliver orders from its regional warehouses within twenty-four hours.
column3: 高效率的物流讓網路商店能在二十四小時內從區域倉庫送出訂單。
column5: logis 像 lodge 住宿：貨物住哪、怎麼搬到目的地

column2: A shortage of skilled welders is the main constraint on how many ships the yard can build.
column3: 熟練焊接工人短缺，是限制這座造船廠能造多少艘船的主要因素。
column5: con 一起 + strain 拉緊：繩子被拉緊，動彈不得

column2: Strict regulations constrain how much banks can lend, which slows growth in the housing market.
column3: 嚴格的法規限制了銀行能放貸的金額，使房市成長放緩。
column5: con 一起 + strain 拉緊：把繩子拉緊，不讓它再長

column2: The packaging line is the bottleneck: every other stage can finish faster than boxes get sealed.
column3: 包裝線就是瓶頸：其他每個階段完成的速度都比箱子封好的速度還快。
column5: bottle 瓶子 + neck 脖子：瓶口窄窄，水流得慢

column2: Adding a second scanner doubled the throughput of the airport security line from sixty to one hundred twenty travelers an hour.
column3: 增設第二台掃描儀，使機場安檢線的處理量從每小時六十人倍增為一百二十人。
column5: through 通過 + put 放：單位時間內放過去的量

column2: The elasticity of demand for luxury watches is high, so a small price rise sharply cuts the number sold.
column3: 奢華手錶的需求彈性很高，所以小幅漲價就會使銷量大減。
column5: elastic 彈性 + ity：價格拉一下，需求會彈多遠

column2: Demand for fashion items is elastic: shoppers quickly look elsewhere whenever the price goes up even slightly.
column3: 時尚商品的需求是有彈性的：只要價格稍微上漲，購物者很快就會另尋他處。
column5: 像橡皮筋 elastic：一拉價格，需求就彈走

column2: Demand for insulin is inelastic, since patients must keep buying it however high the price becomes.
column3: 胰島素的需求缺乏彈性，因為不管價格多高，患者都必須繼續購買。
column5: in 不 + elastic 彈性：橡皮筋拉不動，價格怎漲都得買

column2: A small cash bonus gave workers a real incentive to finish the project ahead of schedule.
column3: 一筆小額現金獎金給了員工提早完成專案的實質誘因。
column5: in 裡 + cent 錢：口袋裡多幾分錢，就更有動力

column2: High taxes on extra income can act as a disincentive for employees to work overtime.
column3: 對額外收入課徵高稅，可能成為員工加班的負向誘因。
column4: a financial disincentive (財務上的阻礙)
column5: dis 反 + incentive 誘因：反過來把人往後拉的力

column2: Customers will pay a premium for coffee that is certified as fair trade and locally roasted.
column3: 顧客願意為經公平貿易認證且在地烘焙的咖啡支付額外的溢價。
column5: premium 像「普利米恩」：付比別人多的錢買頂級

column2: Retailers offer a discount of twenty percent on last season's coats to clear the racks quickly.
column3: 零售商將上一季外套打八折，以便快速清空貨架。
column5: dis 去掉 + count 計算：把價錢算少一點

column2: The volatility of oil prices makes it hard for airlines to plan their fuel budgets a year ahead.
column3: 油價的波動性，使航空公司很難提前一年規劃燃料預算。
column5: volatile 加 ity：價格像坐雲霄飛車上下跳

column2: Cryptocurrency is a volatile asset, with prices that can double or collapse within a few days.
column3: 加密貨幣是波動劇烈的資產，價格可能在幾天內翻倍或崩跌。
column5: vol 飛：價格像鳥一樣忽高忽低亂飛

column2: Compliance with new data privacy rules cost the company millions, but it avoided heavy fines.
column3: 遵循新的資料隱私規定讓公司花了數百萬，但避免了鉅額罰款。
column5: comply 照做 + ance：老老實實照規則走

column2: The new software is compliant with international safety standards, so it can be sold in Europe.
column3: 這套新軟體符合國際安全標準，因此可以在歐洲銷售。
column4: compliant with the law (符合法律)
column5: comply 照做 + ant：乖乖遵守規則的好學生

column2: The start-up used its patent portfolio as leverage when negotiating a better deal with the manufacturer.
column3: 新創公司在與製造商協商更優惠條件時，把專利組合當作籌碼。
column5: lever 槓桿：小小一根棒子就能撬動大石頭

column2: Since happiness is hard to measure, researchers use income as a proxy, though it is an imperfect one.
column3: 由於幸福感難以衡量，研究人員用收入作為代理指標，儘管它並不完美。
column4: a proxy for wealth (財富的代理指標)
column5: proxy 像 pro-xy：找個替身代你出場

column2: The report's one caveat is that the sample included only urban households, so rural areas may differ.
column3: 這份報告唯一的但書是樣本只包含都市家庭，因此鄉村地區可能不同。
column4: a caveat to note (需注意的但書)
column5: cave 像 care：小心喔，這裡有個要留意的條件

column2: A shortfall in tax revenue left the city unable to fund its planned repairs to the bridge.
column3: 稅收短缺使市政府無法為預定的橋梁修繕籌到經費。
column5: short 短 + fall 掉：錢少了一截，掉在目標下面

column2: Creditors forced the failing retailer to liquidate its stock at deep discounts to repay its debts.
column3: 債權人迫使經營不善的零售商以大幅折扣清算存貨，以償還債務。
column5: liquid 液體：把東西化成水一樣的現金

column2: During the liquidation of the bankrupt airline, its aircraft were sold to rival carriers.
column3: 在破產航空公司的清算過程中，其飛機被賣給了對手業者。
column5: liquidate 加 ion：公司資產一件件換成現金還債

column2: A highly leveraged buyout left the company with debt payments that consumed nearly all of its earnings.
column3: 一場高槓桿的收購，使公司的債務還款幾乎吃掉了它所有的盈餘。
column5: lever 槓桿 + ed：借錢當長桿，撬動超大的石頭

column2: After the crisis, many banks began to deleverage by selling assets and paying down their loans.
column3: 危機過後，許多銀行開始透過出售資產與償還貸款來去槓桿化。
column4: deleverage the balance sheet (降低資產負債表槓桿)
column5: de 去掉 + leverage 槓桿：把借來的長桿收起來

column2: Airlines often hedge against rising fuel prices by signing contracts that lock in today's rate.
column3: 航空公司常藉由簽訂鎖定今日價格的合約，來對沖燃料價格上漲的風險。
column5: hedge 是籬笆：圍起一圈籬笆，擋住價格亂跑

column2: Currency hedging protects an exporter from losing money when the exchange rate suddenly moves.
column3: 貨幣避險能保護出口商在匯率突然變動時不致虧損。
column5: hedge 籬笆 + ing：架起籬笆擋住匯率亂跳的操作

column2: The company plans to incentivize sales staff with commissions rather than relying on higher base salaries.
column3: 公司打算以佣金來激勵業務人員，而不是依賴調高底薪。
column5: incentive 誘因 + ize 使：用獎勵把人的動力點亮

column2: Natural attrition, as older staff retire, allowed the bank to shrink its workforce without any layoffs.
column3: 隨著年長員工退休而發生的自然流失，使銀行不必裁員就能縮減人力。
column5: at 向 + trit 磨：員工一個個被磨掉、慢慢變少

column2: Merging the two offices created redundancy in accounting, and about forty positions were eliminated.
column3: 合併兩間辦公室造成會計部門人力冗餘，約有四十個職位被裁撤。
column5: re 再 + undant 波浪：多得滿出來，不再需要

column2: Once the new system arrived, many clerks found their roles redundant and were offered severance pay.
column3: 新系統上線後，許多職員發現自己的職位已多餘，並獲得資遣費。
column4: a redundant worker (被資遣的員工)
column5: re 再 + undant 波浪：多得滿出來，不再需要

column2: Market saturation in smartphones means most potential buyers already own one, so growth is slowing.
column3: 智慧型手機的市場飽和，意味著多數潛在買家已經擁有一支，所以成長正在放緩。
column5: saturate 加 ion：海綿吸滿水，再也吸不下

column2: Coffee chains risk saturating a neighborhood when they open three shops on a single block.
column3: 咖啡連鎖店在同一個街區開三家店時，有使該社區市場飽和的風險。
column5: sat 滿足：把海綿吸滿，吃飽喝足

column2: Traders practiced arbitrage by buying gold in one city and selling it for more in another.
column3: 交易員在一座城市買進黃金，再於另一座城市以更高價賣出，藉此進行套利。
column5: arbitrage 像「啊比搭居」：搭車兩地買賣賺差價

column2: Economists compare prices of the same burger worldwide to test whether currencies are at purchasing power parity.
column3: 經濟學家比較全球同一款漢堡的價格，來檢驗各國貨幣是否處於購買力平價。
column5: par 同等：天秤兩邊一樣重，價格相等

column2: The disparity in income between the top and bottom tenth of households widened over the past decade.
column3: 過去十年間，最高與最低十分之一家庭之間的收入差距擴大了。
column5: dis 分開 + par 等：兩邊不再相等，差一大截

column2: Antitrust laws prevent dominant firms from crushing smaller rivals or secretly fixing prices together.
column3: 反托拉斯法禁止主導企業壓垮較小的對手，或私下聯手操縱價格。
column5: anti 反對 + trust 托拉斯：專門反對大公司聯手壟斷

column2: Members of the oil cartel agreed to limit production in order to keep world prices high.
column3: 這個石油卡特爾的成員同意限制產量，以維持世界價格居高不下。
column4: a price-fixing cartel (操縱價格的聯盟)
column5: cartel 像「卡特」：幾家公司串通起來操縱價格

column2: Regulators accused the company of monopolistic practices after it bought every rival that entered the market.
column3: 該公司買下每一個進入市場的對手後，監管機關指控其有壟斷性的行為。
column5: monopoly 獨占 + istic：做法帶有一人獨吞的味道

column2: A fiduciary duty requires a trustee to act in the best interest of the beneficiaries, never for personal gain.
column3: 受託人義務要求受託人以受益人的最大利益行事，絕不為個人利益。
column5: fiduci 信任：別人把錢交給你，你要對得起信任

column2: An outside accounting firm will audit the charity's books to confirm that donations were spent as promised.
column3: 一家外部會計事務所將審計這家慈善機構的帳簿，確認捐款是否如承諾般使用。
column5: audit 像 audio 聽：古時候是聽帳目被唸出來核對
